platforms.name: XRAY.FM Music Submissions Email Route
platforms.country: United States / Portland, Oregon community radio with global streaming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee is stated on the official contact page.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official mailbox is directly usable, but the linked submission guidelines are hosted in a dynamically rendered Google Drive document that must be opened and checked by a human before sending. A human must approve track fit, release status, rights, email copy, links or attachments, metadata and any current requirements in that document.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from XRAY.FM's official contact page, which explicitly publishes submissions@xray.fm for music submissions and links to official submission guidelines. The official homepage shows an active live schedule and stream. The linked Google Drive document was not signed into, downloaded through restricted means or otherwise bypassed. No email was sent and no assets were supplied.

platforms.name: EARMILK SubmitHub and Pillargram Music Submission Route
platforms.feeAmount: Route and pricing are platform-dependent. Any standard or premium credits, paid review options or premiere products must be confirmed in the live SubmitHub or Pillargram workflow.
platforms.manualReviewReason: EARMILK currently accepts music exclusively through external SubmitHub or Pillargram workflows. A human must select the route, authenticate if required, inspect current free-versus-paid credit options and terms, approve the track, private or public link, metadata, rights declarations and any payment before submission.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from EARMILK's official Submit Music and Contact pages. The publication says new music sent through its general contact form is automatically filtered and instructs artists to use SubmitHub or Pillargram instead. The site published current editorial content on July 10 and July 11, 2026. The official contact page publishes david@earmilk.com for media partnerships and events; it is a business contact, not an alternate demo route. No account, external session, credits, form or payment was used.

platforms.name: Stereofox SubmitHub and Groover Music Submission Route
platforms.country: Global independent music publication and playlist curator
platforms.feeAmount: Platform-dependent. SubmitHub may provide standard and premium routes, while Groover may require paid credits. Current pricing and refund or response terms must be checked live.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Stereofox explicitly routes music submissions to SubmitHub or Groover and says email and Discord submissions are not processed. A human must choose and log into the authorized platform, review current credits or pricing, approve track fit, links, metadata, rights, privacy and any payment or cookie choices.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from Stereofox's official contact and homepage pages. The site explicitly states that music sent by email or Discord will go unnoticed and directs artists to SubmitHub or Groover. Its homepage shows active current editorial and playlist content and a 2026 copyright notice. A cookie-consent boundary was observed and was not accepted. No account, message, credits, payment or music submission was initiated.

platforms.name: Acid Stag Gumroad Music Submission Route
platforms.feeAmount: The official site routes Submit Music to a dynamically rendered Gumroad storefront. The exact current product price, deliverables and purchase terms must be confirmed manually before checkout.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The authorized submission destination is an external Gumroad storefront whose live product, price, deliverables, disclosure, refund, account or checkout requirements were not safely available in the static view. A human must inspect and approve the complete offer, track eligibility, rights, assets and payment before proceeding.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from Acid Stag's official website, where the Submit Music navigation points to acidstag.gumroad.com. The publication posted current articles dated July 7 through July 10, 2026. A hidden anti-spam field was observed in the adjacent newsletter form; it is not the submission route and was not manipulated. The Gumroad workflow was not purchased, logged into or submitted.
